title: Case store cost at 1.0 mm (about 8.5 MB per case) in real Chrome after PR 88 (memoised canonical strings)

environment.base: worktree p-d merged with origin/main including PR 88; PR 89 was not on origin/main, so the compare panel was not re-checked
environment.browser: real Chrome (Claude in Chrome), own tab (not the selected tab; visibilityState visible), vite dev on 127.0.0.1:5174, stdio connector with file-IPC driver
environment.load: About 13 GB free RAM at start, no heavy local processes started by me; other agents idle. Machine load was not otherwise measured.
environment.heap: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize / jsHeapSizeLimit (limit 4396 MB). In run 1 the in-page sampler was starved by the busy main thread (no samples during the steps; only idle samples at the end). Run 2 paused at checkpoints and read the heap twice 3 s apart after each step. JS heap excludes some off-heap ArrayBuffers; garbage is not forced out, so values include uncollected garbage.
environment.renderer: No renderer reload (performance.timeOrigin unchanged) and no window error / unhandledrejection events in either run. Console tool errors not separately sampled.

run1_noHeapCheckpoints.heapMB: not captured during steps; idle samples 28-34 MB before the run and after the run 639 -> 522 -> 343 MB while idle (garbage collection)

comparison: caseSave 1.2-2.1 s for cases 1-7 (rising only about 0.1-0.2 s per case) against 2.0/4.2/8.1/10.7 s before; 5th/6th/7th saves 1.4/1.5/1.7 s (run 2) and 1.9/2.1/2.1 s (run 1), no timeouts, 8th case 2.2 s, a 9th refused by the 8-case cap. caseList 0.5-1.0 s (before 1.4-5.6 s). Rename about 0.9-1.5 s, remove about 0.2-1.0 s, export begin 0.4 s for 34 MB and 1.3 s for 59 MB. Export read 29-30 s and import write 29-30 s (about 55-58 ms per chunk, flat across quarters). Import commit 5.5-5.6 s (before 9-15 s, once over 15 s). Archive and all four case revisions equal after the round trip in both runs. Heap is NOT improved at the high end: 1.46-1.86 GB with 6-7 cases in run 2 (about the same as the earlier 1.4 GB), with a jump from 533 MB (4 imported cases) to 1856 MB after two more saves following an import; in run 1 the same sequence ended at 639 MB shortly after and fell to 343 MB, so heap numbers depend heavily on GC timing.

checks.detail: 518 chunks each way about 29-30 s, commit 5.5-5.6 s, hash match
archive revision and all 4 case revisions equal in both runs
peak used heap observed 1856 MB of a 4396 MB limit; not reduced versus the earlier 1.4 GB at 6-7 cases
no reload, no page errors recorded

notVerified: Heap during the steps of run 1 (sampler starved) and any peak between checkpoints in run 2
Whether the heap jump after saves following an import is retained memory or uncollected garbage (no forced GC)
Unloaded foreground-tab timings (tab was not the selected tab)
